title: Lut Gayi Nabi Di Aal Tera Deen Bach Gaya
body:
Ay Rab e Zuljalal, Tera Deen Bach Gaya
Raitan Te Taqseem Hui
Laasha Hoya Pamaal, Tera Deen Bach Gaya
2)Shaam e Ghareeban Alamaa
Zainab Ho Gayi Sar Uryaan
Aaa Vekh Mera Haal, Tera Deen Bach Gaya
Akbar Seenay Phal Khaaya
Khul Gaye Ne Mere Waal, Tera Deen Bach Gaya
4)Veer Ghareeb Sadaween Na
Khaimeya Wich Tarpawee Na
Zainab Jo Aayi Naal, Tera Deen Bach Gaya
5)Hasda Re Mazloom Bhira
Zainab Tur Payi Shaam De Raah
Bharjaiyaan Bhaina Naal, Tera Deen Bach Gaya
6)Deen e Payambar Di Khaatir
Shaam De Zindaan Wich Nana
Rahi Haan Mai Poora Saal, Tera Deen Bach Gaya
Putar Vi Deen Ton Waare Gaye
Aaa Vekh Mera Haal, Tera Deen Bach Gaya
